goals: Verify the performance and reliability of the book deletion API under concurrent load, ensuring it returns expected status codes (200 or 404) when attempting to delete books by ISBN.
activities: Select a random book title from the loaded dataset
Send an HTTP GET request to look up the book by title
Check if the lookup response status is 200
Parse the response body as JSON and extract the ISBN
Send an HTTP DELETE request to remove the book by ISBN if an ISBN was found
Verify the delete response status is either 200 or 404
